# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# fields: COMMAND_RPC_SET_DAEMON::response_t, src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server_commands_defs.h:2643-2647
#         -- EMPTY. The served result is {}: this file's only key is _provenance and fmonero-mock
#         strips every top-level key beginning with "_".
# request: :2613-2640 -- { address, username, password, trusted (OPT false, :2631),
#         ssl_support (OPT "autodetect", :2632), ssl_private_key_path, ssl_certificate_path,
#         ssl_ca_file, ssl_allowed_fingerprints[], ssl_allow_any_cert (OPT false, :2637),
#         proxy (OPT "", :2638) }. fmonero sends only address, trusted and -- when there is one --
#         username/password (§5b, WalletClient::set_daemon).
# THIS CALL IS WHY THE WALLET CAN SYNC AT ALL, AND IT IS EASY TO OMIT (§4.2). The wallet unit
#         deliberately carries NO --daemon-login, because /proc/<pid>/cmdline is world-readable, and
#         wallet2 takes the daemon credential ONLY from --daemon-login (src/wallet/wallet2.cpp:252)
#         or from this call's username/password (:2611-2626). fmonero's own node unit sets
#         rpc-login=fmonero:<32 hex> (§2c), so with neither, EVERY wallet->daemon call gets a 401 and
#         the wallet can never refresh, build a transfer or relay one.
# IT CANNOT BE ISSUED BEFORE open_wallet: on_set_daemon begins
#         `if (!m_wallet) return not_open(er);` (src/wallet/wallet_rpc_server.cpp:4692), i.e. -13
#         NOT_OPEN with no wallet loaded. A "start unit -> set_daemon -> open_wallet" order fails that
#         call every time, never installs the credential, and presents as "the node is unreachable" --
#         the symptom pointing away from the cause.
# A -38 NO_DAEMON_CONNECTION FROM THIS CALL DOES NOT FAIL `wallet open` (:4757-4761): the wallet IS
#         open, it simply has no daemon yet, so fmonero raises the node_down/wallet_down warning and
#         exits 0. Reach that branch from the mock with --fail set_daemon=-38:'no connection to daemon'.
# THE CREDENTIAL IS IN THE REQUEST, AND THEREFORE IN THE --log FILE, which is a test artefact written
#         to a temporary path and never committed. Nothing in tests/fixtures/ carries it. §2c's own
#         claim is that the rpc-login token never appears in --json, -v or a doctor probe.
# NOT IN DESIGN.md §8's deliverable list; added by Phase 0 with its reason recorded in
# decisions/phase0-mock.md and tests/fixtures/README.md ("Additions"). The reason: it is step three
# of the four-step wallet_session::open sequence and also the whole of `wallet set-daemon`, both
# AMBER rows in §4b. With no fixture every `wallet open` against the mock fails at step three.
